title: skill-rails rails file
description: A rails file: the deterministic steps of an AI agent skill. The runner does the run and stop steps; the agent does the skill, prompt and ask steps, one at a time.

name.description: The rails name. The state file and the done command use it.

type.description: list: a list of strings; on the command line, a JSON list, or one item per line or per comma.

enum.description: The allowed values: of the input, or of each item of a list input.

outputs.description: The values that the rails file gives back at its end, in the done report and as the outputs of a uses step: an object of ${{ }} expressions, or one expression that gives an object.

on-failure.description: Steps that run when the run fails, before the failed report: failure.message holds the reason. The run still fails.

if.description: A ${{ }} expression or a bare expression. The step is skipped when it is false.

outputSchema.description: JSON Schema of the output that the agent reports. The runner validates it.

runStep.description: A shell step that the runner runs with bash. It writes outputs to $RAILS_OUTPUT.

run.description: Bash. Pass values with args or env: a ${{ }} in the command is a shell injection. The scripts/ folder next to the rails file, then the scripts/ folder of its plugin, are in PATH.

args.description: Arguments added to the command, each one quoted for bash: a list, or one value (args: ${{ item.dir }}). Values can be ${{ }} expressions; a list adds each of its items, and null, false or an empty string adds nothing. A map adds flags: { --name: value } adds the flag alone for true, the flag before each item for a list, the flag and the value for another value, and nothing for an empty value.

env.description: Environment variables. Values can be ${{ }} expressions; a list becomes one line per item.

stdout.description: Read the outputs from stdout: text gives outputs.value; env reads KEY=value lines; json gives the keys of an object, or outputs.value for another value; jsonl gives outputs.value, the list of the JSON lines, also for one line.

continue-on-error.description: Go on when the command fails; a list of exit codes goes on only for these codes. steps.<id>.outcome is then failure.

until.description: Poll: run the command again until this condition is true. steps.<id> holds the result of the last attempt.

interval-seconds.description: Poll: the wait between two attempts (default 30).

timeout-minutes.description: Poll: the time limit (default 30). With no until, the time limit of one run (default 10).

working-directory.description: The folder where the command (or the other rails file) runs, relative to the project. Can be a ${{ }} expression.

skillStep.description: The agent invokes another skill, then follows the optional instructions.

with.description: The arguments of the skill: a text, or a map of named values that the agent gets as YAML. Their ${{ }} expressions are filled.

prompt.description: The instructions, or the path of a Markdown file with them, relative to the rails file: a single word that ends with .md. Their ${{ }} expressions are filled.

output.description: The output schema: a JSON schema, or the short form { name: string, done: boolean, kind: a | b, files: [string], note?: string }.

continue-on-error.description: Go on when the agent reports that it cannot do the step. steps.<id>.outcome is then failure, and steps.<id>.error holds the reason.

working-directory.description: The folder where the agent does the step, relative to the project: the report then has directory. Can be a ${{ }} expression.

prompt.description: The instructions, or the path of a Markdown file with them, relative to the rails file: a single word that ends with .md. Their ${{ }} expressions are filled.

with.description: Named values that the agent gets as a YAML block after the instructions. Their ${{ }} expressions are filled.

output.description: The output schema: a JSON schema, or the short form { name: string, done: boolean, kind: a | b, files: [string], note?: string }.

continue-on-error.description: Go on when the agent reports that it cannot do the step. steps.<id>.outcome is then failure, and steps.<id>.error holds the reason.

working-directory.description: The folder where the agent does the step, relative to the project: the report then has directory. Can be a ${{ }} expression.

askStep.description: The agent asks the user one or more multiple-choice questions.

oneOf.description: An expression that gives a list of questions: { id?, header?, question, options?, multiSelect?, other?, free? }. A question with no id gets q1, q2 and so on.

max.description: A dynamic ask: the most questions to ask; default 4.

extra-options.description: A dynamic ask: options added to each question that has options.

stopStep.description: The runner ends the run with a message.

preview.description: Text that the question tool shows next to the option, for example a draft to approve.

value.description: The value that the step output holds when the user selects this option; default the label.

oneOf.description: A label, or an expression that gives a list of { label, description } options.

free.description: The user answers with free text. Options are then optional suggestions.

other.description: The user can also type another answer: the output is the label or the text.

foreachStep.description: Runs the steps once for each item of a list. Inside, item is the current item and loop.index its position.

foreach.description: A ${{ }} expression that gives a list, or a list.

usesStep.description: Runs another rails file as one step. Its stop message and status become the outputs of this step.

uses.description: The rails file, relative to this rails file, or the rails file of another skill: skill:<plugin>:<skill> or skill:<skill>.

with.description: The inputs of the other rails file. Values can be ${{ }} expressions.

continue-on-error.description: Go on when the other rails file fails.

forward-stop.description: A stop step of the other rails file also ends this one, with the same message and outcome.

working-directory.description: The folder where the other rails file runs its commands and agent steps, relative to the project. Can be a ${{ }} expression.

repeatStep.description: Runs the steps again and again until a condition is true. Inside, loop.index is the number of the iteration, from 0.

until.description: Checked after each iteration, with the results of that iteration. The loop ends when it is true.

max-iterations.description: The loop ends after this number of iterations, even when until is false. Default: 10.

breakStep.description: Ends the innermost foreach or repeat. The run goes on after it.

noteStep.description: Shows a message to the user (a note in the next report), and the run goes on. An empty message shows nothing.

setStep.description: Computes values with expressions: steps.<id>.outputs.<key>, with their types (booleans, numbers, lists, objects). No command and no agent turn.

oneOf.description: An expression that gives an object: each key becomes an output.

failStep.description: The runner ends the run as failed, with a message: a short form of stop with outcome failure.
